title: The Cover of the DMZ
author: Freya Pemberton
blurb: Silas Kavanagh, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
